newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Sri Lanka diesel, jet at 8-cts premium.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Sri Lanka diesel, jet at 8-cts premium.

text.p: The lowest offer in Sri Lankan state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's tender to buy diesel and jet fuel for May was made at eight cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes for both products, a company source said on Thursday.
The offer was made by French oil firm Total and the combination cargo is for May 5-6 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo.
The tender, which called for 220,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel, received five offers and closed on April 9. It is expected to be awarded later this evening.

In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought from Swiss trader Glencore 200,000 barrels of diesel at 39 cents per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 20-cent premium, c-and-f Colombo.
The combination cargo was for April 21-22 delivery.
